comment: Pinned upstream voice runtime payloads consumed by stage_voice_runtime.py.
Each archive is the public Codex package for the app target; it carries the
private GStreamer runtime this fork re-uses unchanged (identical native source
pins live in third_party/voice/sources.json). The helper binary is NOT taken
from these archives: it is built from this repository, because the runtime
handshake binds the helper to the build commit of the app that spawns it.
Digests are the ones published in the upstream release SHA256SUMS file and are
verified before any archive is extracted.
alsa-lib sources compiled statically into the Linux voice helper by
stage_voice_runtime.py, mirroring the upstream Bazel dependency
alsa-lib is a build input only: the static object code ends up inside
bin/codex-voice-host and no alsa file ships in the runtime.
